questions.prompt: Which DAX function returns the current date and time?
questions.explanation: The NOW function returns the current date and time in the data model, whereas TODAY only returns the date.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT a native data source type in Power BI Desktop?
questions.explanation: Power BI Desktop does not include a native connector for MongoDB; other options are supported.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of a Tableau data source filter?

options.text: Filters data after it is loaded into the workbook
Filters data before it is loaded into the workbook
Filters data in the view only
Filters data in the data model only

questions.explanation: Data source filters limit the data that is brought into the workbook, reducing memory usage and improving performance.
